title: Accordion Players
content: Senior button accordion players a few years back at the All-Ireland competition. They were only on stage for about 6 or 7 minutes, and I was far back in the audience. So I drew each of them small and simple and set up the page as a contrast between them.TheAll-Ireland (Fleadh Cheoil) competitionwill take place this coming weekend, August 19-21 in Ennis, County Clare.
